name: Docker Build and Test (Reusable)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      push_to_registry:
        description: 'Push image to Docker Hub'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      docker_image_name:
        description: 'Docker Hub image name'
        required: true
        type: string
      dockerfile_path:
        description: 'Path to Dockerfile'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'build/docker/Dockerfile'
      context:
        description: 'Build context'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '.'
      tags:
        description: 'Docker image tags (comma separated)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

jobs:
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        if: inputs.push_to_registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ inputs.docker_image_name }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha,prefix=
            ${{ inputs.tags }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build-and-push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ inputs.context }}
          file: ${{ inputs.dockerfile_path }}
          push: ${{ inputs.push_to_registry }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          # If not pushing, load the image into docker for local testing if needed, 
          # but primarily we rely on the build step itself (multi-stage test) to validate.
          load: ${{ !inputs.push_to_registry }}

      - name: Run container tests (if not pushing)
        if: ${{ !inputs.push_to_registry }}
        run: |
          # Extract the first tag from the metadata to run the container
          IMAGE_TAG=$(echo "${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}" | head -n 1)
          echo "Running tests on image: $IMAGE_TAG"
          
          # Run the container to ensure it starts and basic health checks pass
          # Adjust this command based on your application's entrypoint and test requirements
          docker run --rm $IMAGE_TAG || exit 1
          
          # If your app exposes a port, you might want to run it and check health
          # docker run -d --name test-container -p 8080:8080 $IMAGE_TAG
          # sleep 5
          # docker logs test-container
          # docker stop test-container
